meta.name: code-review-assist
meta.description: Augments human code review by summarizing changes, surfacing key review questions, assessing test coverage, and identifying low-risk sections. Use when reviewing a diff, PR, or code snippet as a senior review partner.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码变更，发现关键问题与测试缺口
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要评审同事的代码变更
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes, surface key issues and test gaps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review your teammates' code changes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析代码变更，总结改动内容、指出关键问题、评估测试覆盖，并标记低风险部分。它不会自动审查，而是辅助你更快、更深入地做人工审查。
howto.when: 当你需要审查一个代码差异（diff）、Pull Request 或代码片段时触发。也可以先让 Claude 列出待审的 PR，由你选择后再逐一分析。

say.text: 帮我审查这个 PR，总结改动并指出关键问题。
列出我最近需要审查的 PR，按风险排序。
这个代码片段有什么问题？请用 conventional comments 标注。
say.note: Claude 会分析代码并给出带严重性标签的评论。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude helps you analyze code changes by summarizing the diff, surfacing key review questions, assessing test coverage, and identifying low-risk sections. It acts as a senior review partner, not a replacement reviewer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to review a diff, PR, or code snippet. Optionally, Claude can first list pending PRs for you to select before diving into each one.

say_en.text: Review this PR, summarize changes and highlight key concerns.
List my pending PRs for review, sorted by risk.
say_en.note: Claude fetches open PRs from GitHub and estimates risk levels.

say_en.text: What issues does this code snippet have? Use conventional comments.
